source_reference: Local checks of the repaired working tree before its containing commit. See GitHub Actions for remote-run status; a local result is not a hosted result.

environment.node: 24.19.0 (clean installs and final Node tests); earlier checks also used 26.4.0
environment.dependencies: requirements-ci.txt plus committed project package-lock.json files
environment.python_install_scope: Shared pinned CI environment; not a separate fresh venv for each Python project

checks.name: Python projects
checks.detail: 15 isolated commands, including 20 unittest cases, API contracts and deterministic evaluations

checks.name: Workspace governance
checks.detail: Fixture defaults, existing labels, unknown data, explicit scope, WhatIf, concurrency refusal, backup-before-write, deduplication, read-back verification, idempotence and guarded restoration; all Graph calls mocked

checks.name: Tenant Guard
checks.detail: All three deliberately non-compliant fixtures return the expected drift exit code

checks.name: Grid Manager
checks.detail: 18 tests and the two-scenario CLI demonstration; JavaFX GUI not exercised

checks.name: Content Flow
checks.command: npm ci; npm test; npm run build
checks.detail: Fresh Node 24 install, 5 tests across publication, SQLite and actual local HTTP startup/CRUD/refine/adapt/queue workflow; synthetic inputs, mock AI, no publisher

checks.name: AI Agent frontend
checks.command: npm ci; npm run build; npm run lint
checks.detail: Fresh Node 24 install; Vite build and ESLint

checks.name: Prioritisation UI
checks.detail: Blank and named use case, 0/100 slider boundaries: four runs without exceptions

checks.name: Smart Home
checks.detail: Menu opens/exits and scenario demo runs without a model key; optional explanation provider untested

checks.name: JavaScript dependency audit
checks.command: npm ci audit for both committed locks
checks.detail: 0 known vulnerabilities in each audit on 2026-09-20; not a security certification or a prediction of future advisories

checks.name: Repository
checks.detail: 72 Python sources parse; 236 local Markdown links resolve before this report; count may grow as verification links are added

recovered_failures: Old temporary checkout files were unavailable; the repair was reconstructed in a durable isolated checkout and rerun.
Java tests referenced moved methods; corrected to the current calculation service.
Missing Content Flow SQL migration restored to tracked source.
ISO queue timestamp comparison repaired and tested against due/future/paused/invalid cases.
First local HTTP test could not open a socket in the sandbox; approved local-only retry passed.
First additional mock guard test had test-scope state isolation wrong; fixed the harness and reran successfully.
Maven CLI dependency access initially failed inside the sandbox; approved download/cache access succeeded.
Outdated JavaScript dependencies were updated; final audit reported zero known vulnerabilities.
First hosted Python check found nine case-sensitive evaluation links hidden by the local case-insensitive filesystem; corrected links and added a tracked-case check.
First hosted PowerShell wrapper inherited the expected child drift exit code 1 despite passed assertions; the harness now resets the consumed exit code after assertions.
limits: No live Microsoft tenant changes, cloud deployments, paid LLM calls, social posts or production/business outcomes were tested.
ML results are fixture-specific and do not establish model superiority, forecast accuracy or hiring success.
Local macOS checks are distinct from GitHub Linux CI; inspect the actual Actions result.
The targeted disclosure scan and inspected synthetic chart are not a comprehensive security audit.
Optional npm install-script warnings did not prevent the documented tests/builds; no unnecessary scripts were enabled.
